narrative_engine.thesis: trend down regime (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -3.63 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP), but price sits 2.23σ from the Day VWAP — chasing here pays no edge. Working limit order at the trend-side band 0.01578-0.01589; the offer is earned when footprint absorption or a strong divergence prints at the zone.

plan.triggerRule: limit fill at the zone + bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap)
vetoes: chase guard: > 2.0σ VWAP extension — wait for the pullback

funding: no per-venue OI available — oiWeightedRate8h is the equal-weight mean
funding rates are percent per interval; annualizedAprPct = oiWeightedRate8h(%) x 3 x 365
fundingImpliedAprPct is the funding-implied carry (oiWeightedRate8h annualized) — NOT a basis APR
